tip.title: Pre-hydrate before a hot day out
tip.why: It's heading for the mid-80s on the coast today. Starting the day already hydrated (with some salt) holds up far better than trying to catch up once you're thirsty in a crowd.
how: Drink about 16 oz of water with a pinch of salt or an electrolyte packet before you leave.
Bring a refillable bottle and sip every 20–30 minutes while you're walking around.
tip.ask: I'll be outside at a crowded festival in mid-80s heat all day. How should I plan water, food and shade?

markets.headline: Tech sell-off sank the Nasdaq 2.1% Friday as AI-spending worries mounted.
points: The S&P tech sector fell more than 3%; CoreWeave dropped about 12% on concern over its roughly $50B in debt.
Energy was the one bright spot as oil climbed. Tesla popped premarket on its Roadster reveal but closed down 2.1%.
A hotter CPI print pushed Treasury yields higher, adding pressure.

pick.name: CoreWeave
pick.theme: AI cloud infrastructure — GPUs as a service
pick.what: CoreWeave rents out large fleets of Nvidia GPUs to AI labs and hyperscalers that need training and inference capacity.
pick.why: It's down about 60% from its 52-week high after Friday's 12% drop, and several analysts are calling the debt fears overdone and the sell-off a buying chance. An idea to research, not a recommendation.
pick.risk: Roughly $50B of debt and a few very large customers. If AI spending slows, that debt load gets hard to carry.

btc.summary: Cowen expects the cycle bottom to land in Q4 2026, with an illustrative path toward the mid-$40Ks. He wants the MVRV Z-score below zero and two weekly closes above the 50-week average before calling a durable bottom.

different.title: There's a high-pitched hum that only young people can hear
different.blurb: The 'Mosquito' device emits a 17.4 kHz tone audible to most people under 25 but inaudible to most adults over 30, due to age-related hearing loss called presbycusis. It was originally designed to deter loitering teenagers — but teens repurposed the frequency as a ringtone teachers can't hear.
different.ask: At what age does hearing loss at 17 kHz typically become noticeable?
